attack_1_exact_hq234_single_cell_rebind.shape: forged state with victim owner_ref and SOURCE payload AND source sealed anchor fields; ledger cell rebound
attack_1_exact_hq234_single_cell_rebind.p07_exception: SourceRelationIntegrityError: owner custody by_ref container identity is not anchored to this resolver

attack_2_candidate_coordinated_container.shape: replace victim._by_ref and victim._by_key with source copies, then rebind ledger cell to a state re-anchored to those substituted containers
attack_2_candidate_coordinated_container.honest_note: A test asserting this forgery is evidence of an OPEN DEFECT, not an acceptance PASS.

attack_3_narrower_no_live_container_repl.shape: NO live container replaced. Attacker constructs the state with the SOURCE payload (by_ref/authority_snapshots/hashes/custody_hash) but sets sealed_by_ref_owner = victim._by_ref and sealed_by_key_owner = victim._by_key (the victim's OWN untouched live containers) and sealed_relations_fingerprint = _custody_relations_fingerprint(live_by_ref=victim._by_ref) (the victim's live empty container). Then rebinds only the ledger cell.
attack_3_narrower_no_live_container_repl.finding: The repair does NOT bind the payload (state.by_ref / state.by_key / state.authority_snapshots / state.custody_hash) to the live containers. It only compares attacker-supplied anchor FIELDS against the victim's live containers. Because the attacker can set those fields to the victim's own live containers and compute the public fingerprint, the named blocker F7-RR-04G (lexical ledger cell rebind) is defeated WITHOUT any coordinated live-anchor replacement. HQ235's sub-claim that 'every single admitted reflection primitive is closed' is therefore FALSIFIED.

attack_4_narrowest_payload_by_ref_only.shape: same as attack 3 but the state also keeps the victim's empty by_key payload; only by_ref payload comes from the source
